description: Find elements by visible text, accessible name, or role, and return their refs for use with browser_computer and browser_form_input. Read-only. Cheaper than reading the whole accessibility tree when you know what you are looking for. An empty result means nothing matched — not an error.

query.description: visible text, accessible name, or ARIA role to search for

tabId.description: tab id from browser_tabs_list or browser_tab_create

name: browser_find
